setup.baseline: A mine layer and a target fleet.
setup.variable: Mine count, decay, sweep strength and trait.

procedure: Lay a known number of mines and record the field size.
Move a fleet through and record damage/speed.
Sweep with known beam weapons and record mines removed.
Advance years and record decay, including enclosed planets.
Test Space Demolition detonation and decay modifiers.

documented: Minefields decay 2% per year normally, 1% for Space Demolition, plus 4% per enclosed planet, capped at 50% (documented-only).
Sweeping happens before movement; beam sweep = power x range squared summed over the fleet (documented-only).
Minefields are 75% cloaked if unseen and 75% from non-penetrating scanners (documented-only).

unresolved: Exact field capacity, damage and detonation radius are unknown.
Whether the decay percentages are additive or multiplicative is unknown.
